A running topic on the Engineering Blog is how to build effective agents and design harnesses for long-running work . A running topic on the Engineering Blog is how to build effective agents and design harnesses for long-running work . A common thread across this work is that harnesses encode assumptions about what Claude can’t do on its own. However, those assumptions need to be frequently questioned because they can go stale as models improve.

A running topic on the Engineering Blog is how to build effective agents and design harnesses for long-running work . A common thread across this work is that harnesses encode assumptions about what Claude can’t do on its own. A running topic on the Engineering Blog is how to build effective agents and design harnesses for long-running work .
